hooks.name: tpm-arm
hooks.command: f="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/__SKILL__/scripts/shim_gemini.py"; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f "$f" ]; then exec python3 "$f"; fi; echo '{}'; echo 'tpm guard: python3 or the shim is missing; allowing' >&2; exit 0

hooks.name: tpm-guard
hooks.command: f="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/__SKILL__/scripts/shim_gemini.py"; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f "$f" ]; then exec python3 "$f"; fi; echo '{}'; echo 'tpm guard: python3 or the shim is missing; allowing' >&2; exit 0
